title.narrative: Self-Help Psychosocial Rehabilitation of People Affected by Russia’s Aggression
Self-Help Psychosocial Rehabilitation of People Affected by Russia’s Aggression

description.narrative: Projektets effekt är att återställa livspotentialen och öppna möjligheter för social egenmakt för minst 10000 personer som drabbats av Rysslands aggression genom samhällsbaserade självhjälpsgrupper för psykosocialt rehabiliteringscenter i 20 kommuner över hela Ukraina.

The project’s impact is restoring life potential and opening possibilities for social empowerment for at least 10000 people affected by Russia’s aggression through community-based self-help group psychosocial rehabilitation center model in 20 municipalities across Ukraine.

The projects impact is restoring life potential and opening possibilities for social empowerment for at least 10000 people affected by Russia's aggression in 24 months. To ensure this impact, GURT will further develop and implement a community-based self-help group psychosocial rehabilitation center model in 20 municipalities across Ukraine.
Project outcomes and outputs:
Outcome 1 Community-based nonprofits in 20 municipalities of Ukraine are providing effective psychosocial rehabilitation and support services to demobilized veterans, family members of active, killed, prisoners of war, or missing Ukrainian defenders, and internally displaced people.
Output 1.1 Community-based self-help group psychosocial rehabilitation centers operate following program standards in 20 municipalities. Output 1.2 At least 200 certified self-help group facilitators are capable of providing psychosocial rehabilitation and support services.
Outcome 2 A community-based self-help group psychosocial rehabilitation center network becomes a self-regulated learning and development platform to support its members. Output 2.1 Semiannual learning exchange conferences form vibrant self-help group facilitators' community of practice. Output 2.2 Exchange (study) visits of network members stimulate best management practices sharing and adaptation.
Outcome 3 The community based self-help group psychosocial rehabilitation center model is ready for replication by other national networks and associations. Output 3.1 The program website popularizes the program's results and promotes the model of a community based self-help group psychosocial rehabilitation center. Output 3.2 Toolkit on setting up and managing a community-based self-help group psychosocial rehabilitation center is produced and piloted.
